versions.text: Cockpit control knobs must conform to the general shapes (but not necessarily the exact sizes or specific proportions) in the following figure: Flap Control Knob Landing Gear Control Knob

[(a) Flap and landing gear] control knobs must conform to the general shapes (but not necessarily the exact sizes or specific proportions) in the following figure: Flap Control Knob Landing Gear Control Knob
[(b) Powerplant control knobs must conform to the general shapes (but not necessarily the exact sizes of specific proportions) in the following figure: Power (thrust) Control Knob RPM Control Knob Mixture Control Knob Carb Heat or Alternate Air Control Knob Supercharger Control Knob]
